scripts.features:
BARRAGE - [TD] SNACK Defense!
Update Log & Feature List (2026-10-04)
AUTOMATION
- Smart Deploy: Uses Balanced, Damage Rush, Economy Rush, Set Positions, or Spread Evenly with smart coverage, path placement, spacing, cash reserve, and farm-saving logic.
- Deploy Priority: Controls slot 1-6 priority and limits with Loadout Order, Economy First, Damage First, Cheapest First, or Priciest First.
- Target Priority: Sets per-slot targeting to Smart, First, Last, Strongest, Bosses, Healers, Air, or Keep Current with situational target overrides.
- Auto Upgrade: Uses Balanced, Farms First, Damage First, Cheapest First, or Lowest Level First with deploy/upgrade timing and farm logic.
- Upgrade Priority & Limits: Controls slot upgrade order and per-slot max levels using live tower caps.
MACROS
- Strategy Recorder: Records Placements, Sells, Targets, and Upgrades with optional stop wave.
- Run Saved Strategy: Replays saved strategies with Wave Safe or Fast behavior, recorded timing, failed-step skipping, and wave syncing.
MATCHMAKING
- Auto Queue: Queues Normal or Endless with Next Unbeaten, Highest Unlocked, or selected live levels.
- Auto Loadout: Equips best units or keeps your current loadout, with options to preserve farms, lock equipped towers, and re-equip changes.
- Auto Vote: Handles match votes with Keep Playing or Agree To All behavior.
- Game Speed: Uses Fastest Owned, 1x, 2x, 3x, or 10x with optional Speed Past Cap.
- Match End: Goes to Next Level, Replay, or Lobby after wins/losses with retry handling.
- Tower Sell: Sells farms or selected towers based on wave, low health, or end-of-match timing.
PLACEMENT
- Custom Placement: Saves slot 1-6 positions per map/path.
- Placement Preview: Shows saved positions with configurable color and transparency.
SUMMON
- Auto Summon: Uses Max Pulls, Single Pulls, or Gourmet with live banners, pull limits, gem reserve, and configurable delay.
- Auto Delete: Deletes selected live rarities while protecting new/unselected towers as configured.
- Auto Traits: Rolls equipped or selected slot towers for live traits such as Damage, Speed, Range, Money, Gourmet, Caviar, and Ambrosia.
REWARDS
- Auto Claim: Claims Daily Quests, Weekly Quests, Group Reward, and Index Rewards.
MODS
- Match Mods: Close Sale Popups, Skip Cutscenes, Skip Summon Animation, and Speed Past Cap.
- Player Mods: Fly, Infinite Jump, Jump Boost, Noclip, and Speed with configurable walk, fly, and jump values.
VISUALS
- Path Visuals: Shows Path Route, Path Nodes, and Path Direction.
- Combat Visuals: Shows No-Build Zones, Tower Ranges, and Enemy Info with Distance, Health, and Tags.
- Placement Visuals: Shows valid placement spots and placement surfaces.
